questions.text: A cube painted on all faces is cut into 64 identical small cubes. How many small cubes have exactly two faces painted?
questions.explanation: For an n×n×n cube (n = 4): 3 faces: 8, 2 faces: 12(n−2), 1 face: 6(n−2)², none: (n−2)³ → 24.

questions.text: A man is facing West. He turns left, then turns right, then turns right. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: Right = 90° clockwise, left = 90° anticlockwise, about = 180°. Final direction: North.

questions.text: Gita is taller than Asha. Isha is taller than Nikhil. Yash is taller than Gita. Asha is taller than Isha. Who is the tallest?
